definitions.short: a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder)
definitions.full: H1899. hegeh הֶ֫גֶה noun masculine Job 37:2 a rumbling, growling, moaning : — ׳ה absolute Ezek 2:10 2 t.; — 1 a rumbling, growling sound ׳וְה יֵצֵא מִמִּיו Job 37:2 of thunder, as sound going forth from God's mouth. 2 a moaning וָה ׳קִינִים וָהִי Ezek 2:10 lamentations and moaning and woe . 3 a sigh or moan , as transient, כְמוֺהֶֿ֑גֶה שָׁנֵינוּ כִּלִּינוּ Psa 90:9 we bring our years to an end as a sign , i.e. a fleeting sound (compare RVm VB).
